elements.requirement: Where a penalty notice is imposed in relation to an infringement of a provision of the UK GDPR, the maximum penalty amount is the amount specified in Article 83 of the UK GDPR, or the standard maximum amount if an amount is not specified there.
elements.quote: the maximum amount of the penalty that may be imposed by a penalty notice is— (a) the amount specified in Article 83 of the UK GDPR, or (b) if an amount is not specified there, the standard maximum amount.

elements.requirement: Where a penalty notice is imposed in relation to a failure to comply with an information notice, an assessment notice, an interview notice, or an enforcement notice, the maximum penalty amount is the higher maximum amount.
elements.quote: In relation to a failure to comply with an information notice, an assessment notice , an interview notice or an enforcement notice, the maximum amount of the penalty that may be imposed by a penalty notice is the higher maximum amount.

elements.requirement: Where a penalty notice is imposed in relation to an infringement of section 164A or of regulations under section 164B, the maximum penalty amount is the standard maximum amount.

elements.requirement: In the case of an undertaking, the higher maximum amount is £17,500,000 or 4% of the undertaking's total annual worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
